purpose: Freeze the smallest corrected-teacher-SFT sequence that can test a combined corpus-and-optimizer repair after the valid base-versus-step1000 Fleet comparison is complete.

scientific_boundary.question: Does one epoch of full-weight SFT on message-aligned, exact-tool-contract stronger-teacher demonstrations improve lineage-heldout Fleet task outcomes over the exact base model?
scientific_boundary.confirmed_structural_defect: The retired dense corpus rendered no formal tools and bare bash/submit_report targets, while the heldout OpenCode path exposes full schemas and fleet_bash/fleet_submit_report to the model.
scientific_boundary.causality_boundary: The schema/name mismatch and its template-token expansion are confirmed structural differences, but this plan changes message alignment, tool contract, success provenance, heldout exclusion, learning rate, and warmup together. A positive result supports only that combined treatment for this exact training seed and checkpoint; no individual component effect is identified.
scientific_boundary.claim_if_positive: On the primary clean dev13 stratum, the exact combined corrected-corpus and conservative-optimizer checkpoint met the preregistered paired superiority rule against the exact base.

historical_step1000_role.label: historical flawed-treatment comparator
historical_step1000_role.current_interpretation: It proves that the historical optimizer changed and served the intended model under a corpus and evaluation path now known to be scientifically defective; it does not establish a negative capability effect.
historical_step1000_role.negative_comparator_upgrade_condition: Describe step1000 as a negative treatment comparator only after a fresh outcome-valid, alias-clean, exact-harness matched base-versus-step1000 evaluation satisfies a preregistered negative decision rule.

claims_not_supported: Attribution among message alignment, exact tool-contract repair, successful-report provenance, alias-clean exclusion, learning rate, and warmup
A claim that stronger-teacher SFT generally helps or hurts cyber capability
scientific_boundary.checkpoint_selection: The predeclared terminal one-epoch checkpoint; imitation loss is a health signal only.
retained_mismatches_and_limits: The corrected rows preserve heterogeneous source system and task messages rather than normalizing them to one instruction distribution.
The supervised targets remain action-only demonstrations without student-visible teacher reasoning.
Training uses a 32K maximum sequence and 8K copied-context budget, while Fleet evaluation uses a 262K OpenCode native-compaction/autocontinue context policy.
Only one fixed training seed is planned, so training-seed variance is not estimated.
The treatment deliberately bundles corpus, provenance, exclusion, learning-rate, and warmup repairs; it cannot identify which repair caused an observed effect.
Exact provider-request capture for the model-facing tool contract remains a pre-training blocker rather than an assumed serving identity.

weight_audit.interpretation: The old optimizer changed the intended model and the accepted step1000 export was served; this rules out a no-op or wrong-weight explanation but makes no quality claim.

pr584_blockers.required_evidence: A sealed exact identity-to-family-role roster for all historical selected task versions, derived from reviewed application/task-family lineage and the trusted role anchor.
Version-2 success evidence that retains the exact successful submit-report call ID and all existing model/task/version/transcript/verifier/route/outcome bindings.
An accepted sealed provider-transform contract and sanitized request capture proving Qwen received the exact model-facing tool definitions.
A read-only rehash proving the private normalized source and successor success-evidence files still exist at their bound digests.

additional_admission_requirement.reason: The scientific protocol requires distribution/concentration and explicit per-source and per-family supervised-token caps applied before packing; PR584 does not yet define the cap policy, enforce it in code, test that enforcement, or emit the complete admission evidence.

acceptance: Every row starts at the pinned chat-template system anchor and repeats the original system, task, and exact formal tool schemas.
Every retained tool call/result pair and assistant message is complete; raw token splicing and inherited success after a lost report are rejected.
Every eligible target appears exactly once, copied context and tool observations have zero loss, and readback matches written row digests.
Every reviewed dev/final family alias is excluded before packing and the resulting exact counts and digests are recorded rather than inherited from the retired corpus.
A reviewed immutable cap policy fixes numeric per-source and per-family supervised-token caps before materialization.

Versioned builder code enforces both caps before packing, regression tests fail on either over-cap source or family, and immutable policy, implementation, test, and prepacking enforcement receipts are bound.
The sealed manifest includes the concentration and cap fields above with no unresolved null.

reference_config.use: Structural LR=1e-6 reference only; its corpus, identity, schedule, and runtime are not reusable.

runtime_pattern.gap: The current wrapper is hard-coded to historical identities, zero warmup, and rejects pause/recovery. A new versioned successor must bind the corrected manifest, formulas, and exact rendered optimizer fields.

optimizer_canary.execution_rule: Compile the full one-epoch horizon first and pause at C; the canary is a prefix of the meaningful run, not an independently scheduled short experiment.
acceptance: Exact corpus, model, tokenizer, runtime, optimizer, schedule, seed, topology, and supervised-token accounting match the sealed plan.
Loss, raw and clipped gradient norms, update norms, and learning-rate telemetry are finite with no overflow, restart, or deterministic input mismatch.
The learning-rate trace completes warmup and executes sustained peak-LR updates before the pause.
The forced native checkpoint is complete and sealed; full-weight text-model parameters changed without missing, unexpected, non-finite, or newly all-zero tensors.
An exact reload performs zero optimizer steps, reproduces the checkpoint identity, and is accepted before resume.

meaningful_run.duration: Resume the exact paused checkpoint through optimizer step S, completing exactly one epoch and one exposure of every corrected target.
allowed_operational_changes: new create-once recovery run, output, and W&B identities
exact recovery manifest and receipt bindings
meaningful_run.stop_rule: Stop only for a predeclared operational defect such as non-finite state, restart, identity mismatch, missing progress, or idle-bound failure; do not stop or select on a favorable loss fluctuation.
terminal_requirements: exactly S accepted optimizer steps and complete supervised-token accounting
sealed terminal native checkpoint and recovery state
accepted BF16 export with tensor inspection
accepted staging, registration, and live-parity receipts before scored evaluation

matched_heldout_evaluation.depends_on: accepted meaningful_run artifacts and successor protocol
matched_heldout_evaluation.primary_analysis: Use only the clean dev13 stratum for the preregistered paired superiority claim: exact McNemar conditional-binomial p<=0.05 plus delta_dev>=3/13 with all 13 valid pairs.
matched_heldout_evaluation.final_test_role: Unseal final7 once only after dev13 passes; report it separately as a non-pooled generalization check with a descriptive directional-consistency floor of 2/7.
matched_heldout_evaluation.decision_rule: Report the frozen base-versus-corrected development comparison whether positive, harmful, or not confirmed. Leave final7 sealed unless the development positive rule passes. Do not launch a random recipe sweep in response; any attribution study is a separately preregistered experiment.

fixed_from_the_diagnosed_dense_run: base model revision, tokenizer, and chat template
full-weight BF16 FSDP method and one-node eight-GPU topology
32K maximum length, 8K copied-context budget, global batch 8, and seed 20260920
verified-success teacher eligibility, task-family split authority, one target per epoch, and one-epoch duration
trainer image and normal c1 admission
intentionally_changed: message-aligned windows with repeated system/task/formal tool schemas and exact fleet-prefixed model-facing tool calls
fresh alias-complete heldout-family exclusion and explicit concentration/cap evidence
peak LR 1e-6 instead of 3e-6 and 5% warmup instead of zero warmup
explicit AdamW, weight decay, clipping, planned pause/reload, and terminal selection contracts
fixed_vs_changed.smallest_followup_after_confirmed_step10: If a fresh matched evaluation first confirms a historical step1000 regression, the smallest bundle-separation experiment is one separately preregistered corrected-corpus arm using the historical optimizer and schedule with matched supervised-target-token exposure. Compare it with the exact compatible base and step1000 cells. This estimates the corrected-corpus bundle at the historical optimizer; it still cannot separate message alignment, tool contract, successful-report provenance, or alias exclusion from one another and carries no launch authority here.
fixed_vs_changed.optional_future_attribution_arm: Only if component attribution becomes scientifically necessary, preregister a factorial or single-factor ablation that independently varies message alignment/tool-contract repair and optimizer schedule while holding source eligibility, successful-report provenance, alias exclusion, supervised-token exposure, model, and evaluation fixed. A corrected-versus-historical optimizer comparison alone cannot identify the individual bundled repairs and is not part of this minimum sequence.
